deals.evidence: Kühne stellt dem HSV zur Verbesserung der sportlichen Leistungsfähigkeit über mehrere Jahre die dazu erforderlichen Finanzmittel zur Verfügung.
deals.headline: Kühne agrees multi-year loan to fund HSV squad investment
deals.summary: Shareholder Klaus-Michael Kühne agreed to provide HSV with the funds needed for squad improvement over several years as a loan; total volume not fixed. Repayment was tied to sporting and economic success, with Kühne bearing the risk if targets were missed. In April 2019 the existing loan agreements were adjusted and finally settled with a one-off payment (terms undisclosed).

deals.evidence: Die HSV Fußball AG hat im September 2016 ein Schuldscheindarlehen im Gesamtvolumen von EUR 40 Mio. am Kapitalmarkt platziert.
deals.headline: HSV Fußball AG places EUR 40m Schuldschein loan to refinance the Volksparkstadion
deals.investor: Banks, insurers and pension funds (placement led by UniCredit and Berenberg)
deals.summary: A EUR 40m Schuldscheindarlehen at 5.0% a year, maturing 2026, offered only to institutional and professional investors and clearly oversubscribed; proceeds replaced the existing Volksparkstadion financing and funded further investment in the HSV-Campus and the stadium.

deals.evidence: Das gesamte Emissionsvolumen in Höhe von 17,5 Millionen Euro wurde gezeichnet und zugeteilt.
deals.headline: HSV fully places its EUR 17.5m 2019/26 bond
deals.summary: The HSV-Anleihe 2019|26 was fully subscribed before the subscription deadline; the club says it was repaid on schedule in March 2026.

deals.evidence: Damit hält AMPri 0,68 Prozent der Anteile an der HSV Fußball AG.
deals.headline: AMPri subscribes 31,250 new HSV Fußball AG shares (0.68%)
deals.summary: Capital increase from authorised capital registered on 29 Dec 2020; afterwards the HSV e.V. held about 75.67% of HSV Fußball AG. Price not disclosed.

deals.evidence: das Stadiongrundstück zu einem Kaufpreis von 23,5 Mio. Euro erworben
deals.headline: City of Hamburg buys the Volksparkstadion land from HSV for EUR 23.5m
deals.summary: Sale of the stadium plot to the city with a hereditary building right granted back to HSV to 2087 (extendable to 2117) at an annual ground rent of 1.8% of the land value; proceeds funded the stadium works required for UEFA EURO 2024.

deals.evidence: Die Kühne Holding AG und weitere Kapitalgeber aus Hamburg unterstützen die infrastrukturellen Modernisierungsmaßnahmen mit einem Millionenbetrag in Form eines Darlehens.
deals.headline: Kühne Holding and other lenders fund Volksparkstadion modernisation with a loan
deals.investor: Kühne Holding AG and other Hamburg lenders
deals.summary: A loan described only as a 'Millionenbetrag' from Kühne Holding AG and further Hamburg lenders to fund the stadium modernisation for EURO 2024; amount not disclosed.

deals.date_text: Agreed April 2023, approved 13 June 2023, issued 26 July 2023
deals.evidence: Bereits im April einigte sich die Kühne Holding mit dem Vorstand der HSV Fußball AG auf eine 30-Millionen-Euro-Wandelschuldverschreibung
deals.headline: Kühne Holding subscribes EUR 30m convertible bond in HSV Fußball AG
deals.summary: A EUR 30m convertible bond (468,750 notes) issued to Kühne Holding AG; its terms were rewritten in 2024/25 so that it must convert into KGaA shares by 29 June 2030 at the latest, and the 2024/25 accounts expected conversion by 30 June 2026. No conversion announcement was found.

deals.evidence: erwirbt rund 7,5 Prozent der Anteile an der HSV Fußball AG & Co. KGaA von der Kühne Holding AG
deals.headline: Sparda-Bank Hamburg buys about 7.5% of HSV Fußball AG & Co. KGaA from Kühne Holding
deals.summary: The cooperative bank, an HSV exclusive partner since 2023, became the third-largest shareholder after the e.V. and Kühne Holding and took a supervisory board seat; Kühne Holding also bought the Volksparkstadion naming rights for three years. Price not disclosed.

notes: Revenue is the KGaA's Umsatzerlöse for 2025/26 (1 Jul 2025-30 Jun 2026), its first season back in the Bundesliga, published 24 Sep 2026; 2024/25 was EUR 126.5m (accounts: EUR 126,520,942). Net profit after tax 2025/26 EUR 8.1m (no pretax figure given); equity EUR 87.5m; financial liabilities EUR 16.8m against cash of EUR 50.5m (no net-debt figure stated, so not computed). The 2025/26 release gives only three of six revenue lines (matchday EUR 56.3m, partnerships EUR 31.4m, merchandising EUR 25.3m; 'commercial' here is partnerships only, merchandising not added in) and says personnel costs were 36.9% of total income without an amount, so wages are the 2024/25 figure from the audited accounts (EUR 46,816,004.08). Kühne Holding's current percentage is not stated on any page read (it is 'second-largest shareholder'); Klaus-Michael Kühne died on 23 Aug 2026 and the page does not say what happens to the holding. Whether the EUR 30m Kühne convertible has converted into shares is not stated. No shirt sponsor could be confirmed on a current club page (Orthomol was announced as shirt sponsor in Sept 2020 for two seasons; Hapag-Lloyd is described as an exclusive partner), so shirt_sponsor is null. Supervisory board chair per imprint is Michael Papenfuß; HSV e.V. president not captured. No Forbes/Deloitte valuation or social-follower count on a citable page was found. The earlier record cited footballgroundmap.com for capacity; replaced with the club's own stadium page (same 57,000).

ownership_summary: The professional team sits in HSV Fußball AG & Co. KGaA (an AG until it converted to a KGaA on 1 April 2025), managed by the general partner HSV Fußball Management AG, which the members' club Hamburger Sport-Verein e.V. owns 100%. The e.V. holds 75.1% of the KGaA's votes and capital; Kühne Holding AG (Klaus-Michael Kühne, who died on 23 August 2026) is the second-largest shareholder and Sparda-Bank Hamburg eG, which bought about 7.5% from Kühne Holding in June 2025, the third-largest; AMPri Handelsgesellschaft mbH and other small shareholders hold the rest.
